site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering provider and advertises generative AI development services, rather than describing its approved staffing and recruiting services. It also contains unsupported delivery promises, company claims, and insurance wording that need correction or removal.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI Engineering positioning
llm_problems.issue: The schema positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and provider, contrary to its approved description as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved company description and descriptions of the current services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner
locations.reason: This labels GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner instead of a staffing and recruiting agency.

locations.quote: GoGloby turns engineering into AI-native production.
locations.reason: This presents GoGloby as transforming engineering into a product or production service.

locations.quote: GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner turning engineering into AI-native production
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and repeats the outdated production positioning.

llm_problems.title: Generative AI development offer
llm_problems.issue: The schema advertises generative AI development and delivery services, while GoGloby's listed services are recruiting and staffing engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the development-services offer and describe only the current recruiting and staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: Generative AI development services
llm_problems.source_value: US Data & AI Engineers Recruiting; Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing

locations.quote: Generative AI Development Services
locations.reason: This names a development service that is not among GoGloby's current services.

locations.quote: GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications
locations.reason: This says GoGloby's engineers build AI products for clients, rather than recruiting or staffing engineers for client-run work.

locations.quote: GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications, and agentic workflows
locations.reason: This offers AI product development and delivery as a GoGloby service.

llm_problems.title: Unverified service delivery timeline
llm_problems.issue: The promised delivery of generative AI development services in under four weeks is not supported by the sources.
llm_problems.fix: Remove this timeline or verify it before making the claim.
llm_problems.subject: Generative AI service timeline

locations.quote: Forward-deployed into your team in under 4 weeks.
locations.reason: This promises a timeline for a development service that the sources do not specify.

llm_problems.title: Unverified IP exposure claim
llm_problems.issue: The claim of zero IP exposure is not stated in the sources; they specify client IP ownership and that engineers work in the client's environment.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the zero-exposure claim or replace it with a verified statement consistent with the security facts.
llm_problems.subject: IP exposure

locations.quote: Zero IP exposure.
locations.reason: This guarantees zero IP exposure, which the sources do not claim.

llm_problems.title: Insurance coverage differs
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security
llm_problems.issue: The schema describes $3M combined liability including professional liability, while the Fact Sheet specifies $3M data and cyber-liability insurance.
llm_problems.fix: Change the insurance claim to match the Fact Sheet's coverage description.
llm_problems.subject: Insurance coverage

locations.quote: $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional)
locations.reason: This includes professional liability, which is not part of the Fact Sheet's $3M data and cyber-liability description.

locations.quote: $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) included.
locations.reason: This again claims combined coverage including professional liability, unlike the Fact Sheet.

llm_problems.title: Unsupported staffing turnaround claims
llm_problems.issue: The 72-hour profile delivery and three-to-five-business-day feature claims are not supported; the Fact Sheet states a two-to-three-week start for nearshore staffing.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify these turnaround promises and align the staffing timeline with the Fact Sheet.
llm_problems.subject: Staffing turnaround

locations.quote: Vetted profiles delivered in 72 hours.
locations.reason: This promises a profile-delivery timeline not stated in the sources.

locations.quote: First validated feature in 3 to 5 business days.
locations.reason: This promises a feature-delivery timeline not stated in the sources.

llm_problems.title: Staffing guarantee differs
llm_problems.issue: The schema promises a 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee, while the Fact Sheet specifies a no-cost replacement if performance falls below baseline and cancellation any time in the first 120 days.
llm_problems.fix: Replace this guarantee with the staffing guarantee stated in the Fact Sheet.

llm_problems.source_value: Performance-based replacement at no cost if results fall below baseline; cancel any time in the first 120 days

locations.quote: 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee.
